info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Chemical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程涵蓋多種機率分佈、統計圖表，以及利用統計結果進行估計與假設檢定。課程還包括數據分析和線性迴歸，作為實驗設計的重要基礎。介紹統計學的基本原理及其在工程中的應用，涵蓋的主題包括機率分佈、統計推論、假設檢定、迴歸分析和實驗設計。學生將學習如何收集、分析和解釋數據，以做出明智決策並解決工程問題。課程強調實際應用，包括製程優化、品質控制和系統性能評估。通過實作練習和實際案例，學生將發展出應對複雜工程挑戰的關鍵分析能力。
description.describe_eh: A variety of probability distributions, statistical charts, and the use of statistical results for estimation and hypothesis testing is to be covered. Data analysis and linear regression are included and serve as important foundations for experimental design. This course introduces the fundamental principles of statistics and their applications in engineering. Topics include probability distributions, statistical inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and experimental design. Students will learn to collect, analyze, and interpret data to make informed decisions and solve engineering problems. Emphasis is placed on practical applications, including process optimization, quality control, and system performance evaluation. Through hands-on exercises and real-world examples, students will develop essential analytical skills for tackling complex engineering challenges.

targets.describe_en: Develop data analysis skills and make correct decisions based on the results.

targets.describe_ch: 介紹統計學於工程之應用，以精進實驗技巧和分析與解決製程問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: Introduce the application of statistics in engineering to enhance experimental techniques and the ability to analyze and solve process-related problems.
